title: Comtrya extension manifest
description: Schema for extensions/first-party/*/manifest.json and any third-party extension manifest. The kernel validates every manifest against this schema at load time; load fails on validation error.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest schema version. Locked at v1 for the duration of the v3 cutover.

id.description: Stable extension identifier — `ext_<name>` convention. Used as the dispatch key and the principal URI.

platformWitVersion.description: If present, the extension targets `comtrya:platform@<this>`. Pinned at 0.1.0 for the M0-M13 cutover.

perExtensionWit.description: Path (relative to manifest) to the per-extension WIT directory. Defaults to `wit`.

wasmComponent.description: Path to the Component Model WASM artifact. First-party platformWitVersion extensions use `dist/<id>.wasm`.

contributes.description: Identity-only declarations. Slot bindings, routes, and resource-card registrations happen at runtime through the SDK (registerWidget, registerRoute, registerCard) and are not declared here.

cueSchemas.description: CUE schema snippets this extension registers with the repo CUE config. The kernel writes each snippet into the materialised repo workdir before evaluating `package comtrya`, so the snippet can constrain or extend per-Project shape (e.g. add `pulls?: #Pulls` to `#Project`).

scope.description: Whether ops on this resource kind are gated per-repository by `repository.extensions` ("repository", the default) or always available ("instance").

hostImports.description: Host import groups this extension is permitted to call (storage.read, storage.write, relations.read, etc.).

allowedEmits.description: Event types this extension may emit via events.append.

allowedEventReads.description: Extension ids whose events this extension may read via events.read-recent.

allowedCrossCalls.description: <target-extension>/<op-name> strings this extension may invoke via ops.invoke.

dispatchRoutes.description: Per-op kernel dispatch scope. Each entry declares whether an op is gated by the per-repository opt-in (repository.extensions) and, when it is, how the kernel derives the repository to gate against. Ops absent from this list are not gated in the pre-invoke phase. Every op listed must be a real WIT export, verified at load.

op.description: Canonical <interface>.<op> descriptor of the op this route governs.

scope.description: "repository" gates the op by the target repo's opt-in; "instance" never gates it.

derive.description: How the kernel derives the repository to gate against. Required for a repository-scoped route; forbidden for an instance-scoped one.

strategy.description: "payloadField": the repository URI is a named field on the op payload, known before invoke.

field.description: For strategy "payloadField": the payload field carrying the repository URI.

scope.description: Whether reactor event dispatch to this extension is gated per-repository by `repository.extensions` ("repository", the default — events whose source repository has not enabled this extension are skipped) or always delivered ("instance").
